description: Require `object_type` and `object_id` on `GET /v1/env_var`. The spec makes every query parameter optional, but observed live 2026-11-12 the call fails without both: no parameters, `?object_type=project` alone and `?ids=<id>` alone each answer 400 `{"Code":"BadRequestError","Message":"Must specify both object_type and object_id [...]"}`.
